title: GM Upfitter: 2025 Silverado EV WT Specification Guide (121525)
notes: US WT spec guide for 2025, read by extracting the PDF text layer. 2WT Standard Range (14 MOD) 475 V up to 220 kW, 11.5 kW charging; 5WT Extended (20 MOD) 670 V up to 300 kW; 8WT Maximum (24 MOD) 800 V up to 350 kW; 19.2 kW module on 5WT/8WT or with the XKT package; RYZ NACS DC adapter optional.
